plAssembly.title: Machine assembly
plAssembly.subtitle: Bills of materials for assembled products, approved by a second person, and the assembly orders that use them
plAssembly.noCreate: You can see assembly but not post it. Ask Admin for the production right.
plAssembly.bomsEmptyBody: Write one with "New BOM version": the assembled item and every component per one unit.
plAssembly.approveRule: Someone other than the writer must approve; the version in use is then superseded.
plAssembly.needsApprover: Waiting for a person with the approve right.
plAssembly.approved: BOM approved. Assembly now uses this version.

editor.title: New BOM version
editor.hint: Saving makes a new draft version; someone else approves it before assembly can use it.
editor.saved: Draft v{{v}} saved. Ask someone else to approve it.

post.title: Assemble
post.rule: If any component is short the server lists every short item and nothing moves. Assembled units wait in quarantine for an assembly inspection.
post.done: Assembly {{doc}} posted. Units are in quarantine for inspection.
